result.title: Correlated by Construction: Endpoint Choice and the Validation of Protein Screening
result.summary: Machine learning for protein engineering depends on functional measurements collected at screening scale, but the designs those measurements rank are deployed in processes that run elsewhere. Whether a miniaturized assay remains informative under the conditions of use is usually assumed rather than demonstrated. We describe an automated production and screening platform and test the transfer of its solution-phase metal-affinity measurements to immobilized rare-earth separation. Primary pKd-derived separation factors tracked those measured on covalently immobilized protein across 82 protein-metal-pair measurements from 35 proteins, with pairwise Spearman correlations of 0.878 to 0.923 (pooled Pearson $r$ = 0.836; Spearman $ρ$ = 0.869). Separation factors at a fixed metal pair are insensitive to the ordering shared across the lanthanide series, so these coefficients report protein-specific correspondence directly; permutation of protein identity confirms it, giving a mean scrambled correlation of 0.003 and, for the 17 proteins measured on all three pairs, $r$ = 0.917 against 0.001 ($p \approx 0.001$). Profiles compared as profiles behave differently. An independent comparison against published LAMBS profiles for the same protein backbones (417 proteins, 5,212 paired measurements) reproduced normalized raw elution at $r$ = 0.870, but reassigning protein identity still reached 0.840. High profile-level agreement across assay formats is largely attributable to metal preferences shared across the series rather than to protein identity. Transfer can be demonstrated, but the endpoint decides whether a correlation shows it: a pairwise contrast removes the shared ordering; a normalized profile retains it, and needs a null that reassigns protein identity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文描述一个自动化蛋白质生产与筛选平台，并检验其溶液相金属亲和测量能否迁移到固定化稀土分离场景：在82组蛋白-金属配对及公开417蛋白LAMBS数据上比较不同终点定义下的相关系数，并引入蛋白身份置换零模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 与LVR无直接关联，但其核心警示——看似很高的profile层面一致性可能来自系列内共享排序而非个体身份，必须以置换零模型剥离——可供核查「用latent表示相似度作为推理证据代理」时，相似度是否同样被共享深度、位置等全局结构夸大。
